name: Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma
bio: Zuhayr ibn Abi Sulma was a poet of Muzayna, born in their country near Medina and later resident at al-Hajir in Najd. Al-Zirikli names two of his sisters, Sulma and al-Khansa', and his sons Ka'b and Bujayr among the poets of his family. His Mu'allaqa celebrates peacemaking between Abs and Dhubyan, and the tradition that he revised a poem for a year gave some of his work the name hawliyyat, or year-poems. Al-Zirikli places his death thirteen years before the Hijra (609 CE).
